entries.detail: TinyCThread 需要手工物化 CMake compile database 路径和显式 scope
entries.detail_en: TinyCThread requires manual CMake compile-database path materialization and explicit scope
entries.suggestion: 人工确认后为 B1 创建独立 change
entries.suggestion_en: Create a separate B1 change after human confirmation

entries.detail: 本验证集未包含 std::thread，因此没有有效分母
entries.detail_en: The validation set contains no std::thread case, so there is no valid denominator
entries.suggestion: 先扩充人工真值语料再决策
entries.suggestion_en: Expand the human-truth corpus before deciding

entries.detail: TinyCThread 的用户回调经分配对象和 wrapper 间接传播，当前线程模型保持保守
entries.detail_en: TinyCThread propagates user callbacks indirectly through an allocated object and wrapper, so the current thread model remains conservative
entries.suggestion: 以受限 callback provenance 为范围单独设计，不承诺通用指针分析
entries.suggestion_en: Design a separate bounded callback-provenance change without promising general pointer analysis

entries.detail: 固定语料的 fence 和 CAS case 分别暴露 schema 失败与 unsupported frontier
entries.detail_en: The fixed fence and CAS cases expose a schema failure and an unsupported frontier respectively
entries.suggestion: 先修复 fence 原始事实兼容，再独立设计 fence/RMW 证明
entries.suggestion_en: Fix fence raw-fact compatibility first, then design fence/RMW proofs separately
